🌟 A Proud Moment for ZIES! 🌟
ZIES is immensely proud and honoured to have successfully organised the Global Education Fair & Career Guidance Programme at Blue Bells Public School – Unit 1, Jhansi.

We sincerely extend our heartfelt gratitude to the School Management, Principal, teachers, students, and all participating universities for their valuable support, cooperation, and trust.

It was wonderful to witness the enthusiasm and curiosity of students as they explored diverse opportunities in higher education, global universities, and future career pathways.

Your continued trust and encouragement inspire us to create more meaningful opportunities for students and strengthen connections between schools and leading institutions from across India and the world.

Thank you, Blue Bells Public School, for being a valued part of the ZIES journey! 🌍🎓
ZIES – Connecting Dreams with Global Opportunities.
Dr Nitin Williams Rajesh Rathore Faisal Hasib Sarvesh Kumar Arpit Solanki
